clean_segment.name: Clean segment (room)
clean_segment.description: Clean rooms by segment id on a B01 Q7/Q10 vacuum. Get the ids from the vacuum entity's segment list or the map camera rooms.

segment_id.name: Segment ids
segment_id.description: One or more room/segment ids, e.g. [16] or [16, 17].

clean_settings.name: Clean settings
clean_settings.description: Set suction power, water flow, cleaning mode (vacuum / vacuum+mop / mop), repeat cycles and cleaning route on a B01 Q7 vacuum. All fields are optional; only the ones you pass are changed.

fan_speed.name: Suction power
fan_speed.description: One of: quiet, balanced, turbo, max, max_plus.

get_maps.name: Get maps
get_maps.description: Current map id and room ids/names for the targeted vacuum(s). Response-only.

get_vacuum_current_position.name: Get current position
get_vacuum_current_position.description: Robot x/y (map pixel coordinates) from the parsed live map. Response-only.

set_vacuum_goto_position.name: Go to position
set_vacuum_goto_position.description: Q10 only: drive the robot to a map coordinate.

set_vacuum_zoned_cleaning.name: Zoned cleaning
set_vacuum_zoned_cleaning.description: Q10 only: clean a rectangular zone, optionally repeated.

blocked_command.title: Blocked command: {command}
blocked_command.description:
Something in Home Assistant (a script, automation or
another integration) tried to send the command `{command}`, which
could delete, replace or corrupt the robot's saved map or rooms.
The integration refused it before anything left Home Assistant -
the map and rooms are untouched. If you did this on purpose, the
command is on the integration's map-protection blocklist and cannot
be run through Home Assistant; use the Roborock app instead.

device_failures.title: Roborock device unreachable ({failures} failed commands)
device_failures.description:
Several commands in a row failed even after automatic
retries. The robot may be offline, asleep, or out of cloud reach.
This clears itself automatically on the next successful command.

stale_area_mapping.title: Room mapping needs redoing: {entity_id}
stale_area_mapping.description:
None of the rooms saved in the segment-to-area
mapping exist on the robot's current map (e.g. after a map
recovery), and no new mapping could be built automatically - so
vacuum.clean_area will report that no mapping is configured.
Rooms the robot currently reports: {valid}.
Re-map areas in the vacuum entity's segment mapping editor, or
use roborock_b01.clean_segment with room ids from the map camera.
The issue clears itself once a verified mapping exists.

map_failure.message: Could not fetch the map from the device.

position_not_found.message: The robot position is not present in the current map data.

invalid_segment.message: Invalid segment id(s): {segments}. Use numeric room ids from the map camera or get_maps.

unknown_segment.message: Room id(s) {segments} do not exist on the robot's current map - the device would start a full-house clean instead. Valid rooms: {valid}. Refresh the room list from the map camera. The map and rooms are untouched.

invalid_q10_coordinate.message: Invalid Q10 coordinate: ({x}, {y}). Coordinates must be integers aligned to the robot's 5 mm grid.

invalid_q10_zone.message: Invalid Q10 zone. Coordinates must be integers aligned to the robot's 5 mm grid; repeats must be 0-2.
